name: Corn wine
summary: Mong corn wine, distilled by hand from mountain corn and leaf yeast, heavier or lighter depending on how much the distiller draws. Buy it at the Sunday market in Đắk R'Măng.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023, and Bao Lam Dong on 22 Sep 2023.
howToEat: Bao Lam Dong says the corn is grown on the high mountains, the yeast is made from leaves, and the wine is distilled by hand. Strength is heavier or lighter depending on how much is taken.
where: Sunday market at Đắk R'Măng, Đắk Glong.
seoTitle: Ruou ngo at Dak R'Mang — Mong corn wine
seoDescription: Mong corn wine, leaf yeast, distilled by hand, sold at the Sunday market in Đắk R'Măng.
